name: Cage Grind
storyline:
You begin as an unknown amateur fighter with nothing but raw talent, an empty wallet, and a dream of becoming world champion.

Starting in rundown local gyms and fighting on small underground cards, you train, improve your attributes, collect better gear, and build a reputation one victory at a time. Every fight brings new opportunities—but also tougher opponents, injuries, rivalries, and choices about how to spend your growing fame and fortune.

As your following grows, sponsors take notice. You move into better gyms, hire experienced trainers, unlock new fighting styles, and earn your way into major promotions. Outside the cage, you can enjoy the rewards of success—or waste them on luxury, gambling, and bad decisions.

Your ultimate goal is to capture the championship, defend your title, and retire as a legend. But in Cage Grind, reaching the top is only half the battle. Staying there is the real grind.
summary: Cage Grind is a free, browser-based MMA career simulation. Players create a fighter, choose opponents, and set pace, offense, and tactics for simulated bouts decided by knockouts, submissions, or judges’ decisions. Victories earn permanent attribute upgrades, while followers, sponsors, collectible gear, and Aura shape career progression. A shared roster, asynchronous player challenges, world championship bouts, and the Cage Feed connect individual careers. Open Gym offers practice matchups and coaching reports without affecting official records.
